title: Context Matters: Improving the Practical Reliability of LLM-Based Unit Test Generation
datasets: Defects4J projects Chart, Math, Lang, Time; industrial corpus is private 8 projects / 183 methods.
models: 9 local models; includes Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct and 32B. Defects4J comparison uses 32B.
license: Paper CC BY 4.0; GitHub repository has no declared license.
input_setting: Focal-method test generation with project context, deterministic skeleton and static repair; measures coverage/compile/pass/mutation, not F2P historical-bug detection.
reproduction_grade: not feasible from partial public artifact; core pipeline/Defects4J manifest/evaluator absent
concept_hook: Context-aware test skeleton, framework context and deterministic repair for practical reliability.
limitation: Full source and industrial data explicitly withheld; no Defects4J focal ID manifest or evaluator; no F2P or RCA metric.
